title: Measure Your AI Visibility
description: Build a repeatable prompt library, log brand mentions and citations, and turn observed gaps into an action plan.

sections.heading: Build a prompt library around real questions
sections.body: Write twelve to twenty prompts spanning general advice, specific needs, current information, brand questions and community perspectives.

sections.heading: Record answers and compare six measures
sections.body: Log tool, date, location and sign-in conditions alongside brands, citations and factual accuracy. Review mention rate, first mentions, credit rate, source mix, description and accuracy.

sections.heading: Turn patterns into priorities
sections.body: Use the gap-to-action worksheet and monthly scorecard to assign owners and next steps. Review patterns across repeated runs and revisit the prompt library quarterly.

methodology: Run the same prompt set under documented conditions and save every answer, including unfavorable results. Use the workbook’s stated denominators consistently when comparing periods, and log tool or version changes.
limitations: Results are a sample of variable AI answers, not stable rankings or causal evidence. Visible citations show attribution; they do not reveal every retrieved or training source. Missing citations do not prove that content was absorbed without credit.
